verdict.rationale: Morph documents a Batch component that runs "thousands of chat completions offline at half price," which is a real bulk-operation capability for chat completions. The evidence is a single one-line doc mention, with no detail on job submission, status tracking or result retrieval, and no evidence of bulk modes for Fast Apply, Compact or Reflexes. Missing for 10: documented batch workflow details (submission, polling, result handling), bulk support for the specialized tools beyond chat completions, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch use.
